values.display: we automatically apply the VPC's default security group
You can change the security groups

claim: When you associate a subnet with a Client VPN endpoint, AWS automatically applies the default security group of the VPC. You can change the security groups after you create the endpoint.
note: d12-083. register-12: the FAQ sentence about allowing access only from the applied security group was moved out; it is client-vpn-faq-security-group-restrict-app-to-vpn-users.

qualifiers.condition: you can change the security groups after you create the endpoint
